title: Refund function with no double refund
intent: Implement a refund function. Refunds must be positive, must never exceed the original payment, invalid or cancelled orders must fail, and the same order cannot be refunded twice.
critic_improved_spec: Refund amount must be positive, must not exceed the remaining refundable balance, cancelled orders must fail, and successful refunds must update refunded_total so the same money cannot be refunded twice.
missing_requirements: Refund must not exceed original payment
Same order cannot be refunded twice
Invalid or cancelled orders must fail
Refunded state must be updated after successful refund
expected_naive_failure: The naive public spec can select an implementation that accepts repeated refunds because it only checks that the amount is positive.
expected_defense: The omission-aware critic spec should reject implementations that allow double refunds or over-refunds.
